visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens at night with large, golden fireworks exploding in the dark sky. A massive crowd of people is visible in silhouette, many holding up smartphones to record the display. The atmosphere is festive and bright with the light from the pyrotechnics. (2) The scene cuts to a daytime waterfront walkway under a cloudy, overcast sky. A young man with a black baseball cap worn backwards and a striped green shirt turns around to face the camera. A hand from an off-screen person touches his shoulder as the city skyline and a river are visible in the background. (3) The man walks through a busy outdoor festival ground during the day, being led by the hand. He is then shown in a close-up shot eating a large piece of fried food on a stick, looking directly at the camera with a satisfied expression. (4) Back at night, the scene shifts to a large outdoor stage where a musical duo, the band Power Station, is performing live. Large professional speakers and a lit-up stage are prominent. The crowd is dense, watching the performance under bright stage lights. (5) A yellow Toyota SUV with black Uber branding is positioned on the stage. A woman in a tan suit, Miao Keli, walks out next to the car. The main character is seen in the crowd looking extremely shocked and excited, clapping his hands together. (6) On stage, the woman interacts with the band while holding a doll wrapped in a blanket, performing a dramatic and comedic skit. The main character watches intently from the audience, appearing impressed by the surprise performance. (7) Finally, the man is seen walking through a parking lot at night, smiling at the camera. The video ends with him sitting in the back seat of a car, wearing his seatbelt and talking to someone off-camera as the vehicle's interior lights illuminate him.
